Subject: Board briefing prep — QBR runway, consolidated forecast & account anchors

Team / Samir,

We're landing the QBR packet for the board next week and need a tight consolidated runway + per-account anchors for Northstar. Target deliverables:
- A single-row consolidated forecast (ARR / committed / timing) plus +/- variance vs. last Q (one slide).
- An account-by-account summary for the top 8 deals (owner, close plan, risks, next milestone — one line each).
- A short action matrix (who owns what before the board deck submission).

I've attached a working spreadsheet (qbr-account-matrix.xlsx) and the latest draft deck (board-deck-draft-v2.pptx). Please:
1) Owners (Ben/Marissa/Laura) — fill the account rows you own in the matrix by EOD Thursday PST. Use the "Commit" column when you're certain of timing.
2) Samir — if there are any internal gating items or updated timing from your side, flag them in replies.
3) Grace — can you run a quick sanity check on the consolidated numbers and flag any accounting/recognition risks?

We want the final numbers locked by Friday so I can finalize the board slide and send to the CEO on Monday morning.

Attachments: [qbr-account-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [board-deck-draft-v2.pptx (presentation)]

Thanks,

--
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales Strategy, Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0192
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@northstar.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Thanks Tessa — confirmed on our side. Quick updates:
- We've pushed the EDI integration milestone for account NS-347 (Alder) by two weeks due to resource reprioritization; that reduces expected Nov ARR recognition for that deal by ~$12k this quarter.
- Legal is reviewing the addendum for NS-501; expect sign in ~10 business days if no additional redlines.

I've attached a short note from our finance team with the adjusted recognition cadence (see forecast-rollup-v3.pdf). We'll also have our CFO on standby if you need clarification for the board.

Samir
